name: a paid-for claim hard-cuts into an accusing question
looks: On a near-black card, a bold line states what the viewer paid for, with a dim timestamped receipt line underneath. It hard-cuts to a white card asking what they actually got, the second line underlined by hand. The rhythm is two flat cards, same size type, no crossfade.
build: Two full-bleed DOM cards, opposite grounds (dark then light); each headline is one block, with a small opacity/y entrance under 0.2s so the hard cut doesn't feel completely static. The underline under the second card's question is a scaleX reveal from the left, power2.out.
sound: A dry tick on each card's arrival, a short scratch as the underline draws.
prompt: Open on a flat card stating plainly what the viewer paid for, with a small receipt-style detail line. Hard-cut to a second card, same rhythm, opposite ground colour, that turns the claim into a pointed question, underlining the sting by hand. No crossfade between the two.
